title: Where should a limited casework team spend next week's time?

source.title: CGB — Consumer Complaints Data
source.credit: Source: Federal Communications Commission, CGB — Consumer Complaints Data.
source.boundary: Consumer-submitted Phone/Internet complaint intake to the US regulator, not an operator contact-centre queue; allegations are not independently verified.

assumptions.capacityUnit: Hypothetical case-processing slots per staff-week; no observed handling time or resolution outcome
assumptions.backlog: Simulated one-stage FIFO backlog; clean start, weekly pooling, retained terminal backlog
assumptions.objective: Minimize worst projected unprocessed share, then remaining cases and internal staff reallocation
assumptions.hindsight: Current-week actual-intake comparison, not a global horizon bound
assumptions.interaction: All scenario results are precomputed from the frozen evaluation

description.actual_intake: all test weeks and queues zero

description.forecast_rule: hold the original observed-series forecast path fixed; stress is an exogenous unforecast shock, not a re-fitted series
